say: Your brain has about eighty-six billion neurons.
And right now, they are talking to each other.
scenes.title: Neurons

say: A neuron is a cell with short branches that listen, and one long wire that speaks.

say: A signal races down the wire as a tiny electrical pulse,
at up to about one hundred and twenty meters per second.
